description: Sign in to Microsoft Teams and let agents list chats and read bounded recent history. Sending is disabled in this slice.
configHelp: Open the Teams Client view and click Sign in. The pinned m365 CLI installs into the plugin-owned runtime path during that action when Node.js 20+ and npm are available. Sign-in opens the browser for the owner's work/school account. Agent verbs: `accounts`; `use <account-id>`; `chats`; `history <chat-id> [n]`; `health`; `logout`. `send` and `preview` return an explicit refusal because sending is not enabled in this slice. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB. Agent commands require the host grant `agent_commands` after plugin installation.
